sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **术语**：KMAC / cSHAKE 族（KMAC / cSHAKE）。SP 800-185 定义一组由 KECCAK 派生的函数。摘要称 cSHAKE「is a customizable variant of the SHAKE function, as defined in Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 202」，其计算把 encode_string(N) 与 encode_string(S) 一并做字节填充后再接输入。KMAC「is a PRF and keyed hash function based on KECCAK」，从 bytepad(encode_string(K)) 起始并追加右编码的输出长度。TupleHash 则被设计为「hash a tuple of input strings ...in an unambiguous way」。
statement.en: **Term**: KMAC / cSHAKE.It is registered under authentication and AEAD, hashes.

statement.zh: 定制分两个串：N 是「function-name bit string, used by NIST to define functions based on cSHAKE」，S 是用户自选的 customization 串；当两者都为空时 cSHAKE 等价于 SHAKE，即 cSHAKE128(X, L, "", "") = SHAKE128(X, L)。§3.4 警告用户不得自造 N 值，否则「could cause interoperability problems with future NIST-defined functions」。KMAC 与 SHAKE/cSHAKE 的区别在于「altering the requested output length generates a new, unrelated output」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in authentication and AEAD, hashes, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 这四个函数「All support two security strengths: 128 and 256 bits」。表 1 给出等价用法：KMAC128(K, text, 128, S) 对应 AES-CMAC，KMAC256 取 256 位输出对应 HMAC-SHA256，取 512 位输出对应 HMAC-SHA512。§4.3.1 另外定义 KMACXOF128 与 KMACXOF256，通过把编码后的输出长度设为 0 来获得可变长度输出。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 密钥与输出长度是主要误用点。§8.4.1 规定「shall not select an input key, K, whose length is less than their required security strength」；§8.4.2 规定用作 MAC 时输出长度不得小于 32 位，选择小于 64 位必须先做仔细的风险评估；§8.3 针对碰撞与原像说明这类函数无论输出多长都可能以 2 的 128 次方工作量被攻破，「a longer output does not, in general, improve its security against these attacks」。KMAC 的密钥 K 允许任意长度包括零长度，因此批准用途须自行满足密钥长度下限。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: SP 800-185 由 Kelsey、Chang 与 Perlner 撰写，2016 年 12 月发布，把 FIPS 202 的 SHAKE 扩展到可定制、keyed 与元组哈希场景，并为整族函数定义 128 与 256 两个安全强度档位。
statement.en: Registered period: Age of Standardization.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
